# Sarah-cat

## Overview

- **Age:** eight years old  <sub>[v3 ch.Relationships P59](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0059)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v3 ch.Relationships P58](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0058), [v3 ch.Relationships P62](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0062)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  <sub>[v3 ch.Nell-girl P24](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0024)</sub>

## Appearance

Sarah-cat is a giant, smooth, gray-and-white feline. She carries herself with a massive sense of self-respect.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P58](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0058)_

## Personality

Sarah-cat is recognized as an extraordinary mouser. This exceptional hunting ability is associated with her being eight years old.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P59](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0059)_

## History

Sarah-cat was originally given to [Aunt Euphemia](../character/aunt-euphemia.md) as a gift from her laundress. After [Aunt Euphemia](../character/aunt-euphemia.md) moved into Tabby's Place, she brought Sarah-cat and her other cat, [Joseph](../character/joseph.md), to live with her and the girls. Later, during an awkward visit from [Cyril](../character/cyril-lisle.md) Lisle's family, Sarah-cat and the other cats jumped on Mrs. Lisle.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P46](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0046), [v3 ch.Relationships P51](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0051), [v3 ch.Relationships P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053), [v3 ch.Relationships P58](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0058), [v3 ch.Relationships P65](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0065), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P3](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0003), +3 more_
